title: SAC Best Practices: Working with Private Draft Versions
content: Guides the user on creating a private copy, adjusting numbers safely, and executing version management publish commands: (1) Open the target SAC Planning Story, (2) Click Version Management in the toolbar, (3) Select your uncommitted private version (e.g., Draft_v1), and (4) Click the Publish icon to merge private edits into the Public model category so teammates and managers can view them.

category: SAC SOP / Aggregation & Formula Rollup Rules
title: SAC Aggregation Rules: Margin Percentages vs Totals
content: Explains why ratios and percentages cannot be summed up additively, as formula accounts are calculated as a weighted rollup ratio: [Gross Margin] / [Revenue]. In SAP Analytics Cloud, MARGIN_PCT uses FORMULA aggregation and WEIGHTED_AVG rollup across cost center hierarchies rather than a simple additive SUM of child percentages.

category: SAC SOP / Data Locking & Period Close Governance
title: Data Lock Consoles & Temporal Hierarchy Policies
content: Explains corporate deadlines and locked timeslices to secure historical records. Once a monthly or quarterly planning cycle closes (e.g., JAN_2025_PERIOD / January 2025), Finance Controllers set the slice state to LOCKED in the SAC Data Locking Console. Standard analysts cannot edit locked slices without submitting an IT4You unlock request.

category: SAC SOP / IT4You L3 Support & COE Escalation
title: How to escalate Data Action script bugs to the SAP Center of Excellence (COE) Team
content: Process of drafting a debug trace and routing via IT4You: Capture the affected Model ID (e.g., CORP_FINANCE_PLANNING), exact cell coordinates (Account, Version, Cost Center, Time), and chronological audit log evidence showing the SYSTEM_SAC_SCHEDULER Multi Action overwrite. Route the structured JSON payload to group SAP-BTP-PLANNING-L3 with priority P2 - High.
